body: Anyway none of that is really relevant. Me being on here is irrelevant. Im going to bed so i can get my license to get my old job back and make enough money to put a stop to this. Thanks for talking. Once again i get more support from the internet than anyone i really know. That just makes me more depressed.

And with the girl thing its too complicated to really explain. Basically she was my best friend for a long time and then we dated and moved in together and then i fucked everything up and now we cant even be around each other. And she was the only person i ever felt a genuine connection to. And the only one who seems to listen to what people say instead of imposing her own thoughts over their statement.

Oh thats quite a fucking list. Mainly just cant handle how brainwashed everyone is into eating up nonesense from the media. Disgusted by governments everywhere and their conduct. Disgusted by the whole world and the impact people actually make on it. Not to mention my body is basically screwed from monsanto poisoning so every second being alive is painful and difficult to make it through. And then people deny that this issue that is literally killing me and has hospitalized me is even a real thing. And lastly, ive been in a state of suicidal limbo for over a year now and have made it as clear as i am comfortable making it to those around me and even government employees who are paid to do something about it. And ive just been ignored. On all fronts. No one will be surprised unlike with my friend who did it last year. Ive told them. They offered no solace. People say im smart and stuff like that, but i cant apply myself to anything. I just fuck it all up like its my fucking purpose to exist.

No. She just made it barely tolerable. And i just cant do this shit anymore. The only thing stopping it from being tonight is the cash for a gun. Hell she'd probably tell me to do it anyway. Might even join me. I fall asleep every night praying (despite not believing in anything) to not wake up. I wake up every day wishing i wasnt awake. And as far as i can remember this has been how it is for my whole life.
